abstract: Maintains materials testing facility credentials and routine sample analysis capacity
system_message:
You are the Metallurgical lab director (MLD), responsible for maintaining materials testing facility credentials and routine sample analysis capacity, as well as tracking spectrometry throughput.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Spectrometry throughput（SPECT）
information_points.content:
MLD-SPECT-1K4：According to the quality manual audit sheet for the Rapid High-Temperature Fractography Protocol, the inductively coupled plasma spectrometer calibration frequency is mandated at every 30 d.
MLD-SPECT-XWT：For the Continuous Acoustic Emission Tomography Protocol, the quality manual audit sheet mandates a spectrometer calibration frequency of every 14 d for inductively coupled plasma instruments.
MLD-SPECT-AFE：Under the Sub-Surface Eddy Current Volumetric Protocol, the required spectrometer calibration frequency for inductively coupled plasma spectrometers is 7 d.

information_points.title: Maintains materials testing facility credentials and routine sample analysis capacity（LABM）
information_points.content:
MLD-LABM-TM7：Under the Continuous Acoustic Emission Tomography Protocol, the designated testing facility does not hold active ISO/IEC 17025 metallurgical laboratory accreditation, while its planned routine sample analysis count totals 140 tests.
MLD-LABM-TVS：For the Rapid High-Temperature Fractography Protocol, the designated metallurgical test facility holds active ISO/IEC 17025 metallurgical laboratory accreditation for mechanical and fractographic testing, and the planned routine sample analysis count comprises 180 tests across tensile, hardness, and microstructural optical microscopy runs.
MLD-LABM-4XD：For the Sub-Surface Eddy Current Volumetric Protocol, the testing facility maintains active ISO/IEC 17025 metallurgical laboratory accreditation, and the laboratory workload schedule allocates a routine sample analysis count of 210 tests.
